events.title: Supreme Court extends stay in Danco Laboratories, LLC v. Louisiana, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court, through Associate Justice Samuel A. Alito, Jr., issued an order extending the stay previously granted on May 4, 2026, in the case of Danco Laboratories, LLC v. Louisiana, et al. The stay is extended until 5:00 p.m. (EDT) on May 14, 2026. This procedural action allows the current legal status to remain unchanged while further considerations are made.
events.why_relevant: The extension of the stay affects the immediate legal proceedings and maintains the status quo pending further judicial review.

events.title: Supreme Court denies stay in Scott v. McDougle
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States denied the application for a stay in the case of Scott, Don, et al. v. McDougle, Ryan T., et al., docket number 25A1240. The application was initially presented to the Chief Justice, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the lower court's decision will remain in effect while the case proceeds.
events.why_relevant: The denial of a stay affects the immediate enforcement of the lower court's ruling.
